name: zealllot-proctor
description: PRoctor — AI-driven PR test runner as a Claude Code plugin. Drives a real browser against a running admin (deployed test env or developer's localhost), auto-logs in with form + TOTP, runs role-aware checks per PR.

plugins.name: proctor
plugins.description: AI-driven PR test runner — Claude Code plugin. Analyze diff → plan tests → execute (chrome-devtools/Bash) → auto-fix → report comment. v0.3+ supports auto-login (form + TOTP) against deployed test envs with multi-role admin accounts.
